injury_reports.name: Mark Andrews
injury_reports.summary: Andrews caught three of four targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Rashod Bateman
injury_reports.summary: Bateman caught one of three targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Joe Fagnano
injury_reports.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter confirmed Tuesday that Fagnano (ankle) will start Thursday's game against the Jaguars, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Zay Flowers
injury_reports.summary: Flowers failed to bring in any of his five targets in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Derrick Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Justice Hill
injury_reports.summary: Hill (groin) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Huntley
injury_reports.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tuesday that Huntley (toe) could be a candidate for injured reserve, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sunreports.

injury_reports.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve,  Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injury_reports.summary: Lane caught his only target for 13 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Roger Rosengarten
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: John Simpson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: LaJohntay Wester
injury_reports.summary: Wester went without a target while playing six of the Ravens' 51 snaps on offense in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills. He also returned three kickoffs for 71 yards and one punt for two yards.

injury_reports.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
injury_reports.summary: Hawkins (knee) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice reports.

injury_reports.name: John Jenkins
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Roquan Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (foot) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's practice report.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Tampa
injury_reports.summary: Tampa (knee) is active for Sunday's game versus Buffalo.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Loop
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens placed Loop (groin) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jake Moody
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Moody is on track to be elevated from the practice squad to handle kicking duties for the Ravens in Thursday's game against the Jaguars,  Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injury_reports.summary: Allen (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Nate Boerkircher
injury_reports.summary: Boerkircher caught his lone target for a 31-yard touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Ezra Cleveland
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Travis Hunter
injury_reports.summary: Hunter failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.

injury_reports.name: Trevor Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing three times for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jakobi Meyers
injury_reports.summary: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez (hand) was listed as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Brenton Strange
injury_reports.summary: Strange caught both of his targets for 55 yards during Sunday's 42-7 win over Indianapolis.

injury_reports.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thomas "has been the area of interest for a lot of other teams" leading up to the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Ian Rapoport of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Bhayshul Tuten
injury_reports.summary: The Jaguars listed Tuten (ankle/foot) as a non-participant in Tuesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Parker Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington brought in one of two targets for 16 yards and rushed once for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Branson Combs
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: DaVon Hamilton
injury_reports.summary: Jaguars coach Liam Coen confirmed Monday that Hamilton will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a torn quadriceps in Sunday's win over the Colts, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

injury_reports.name: Antonio Johnson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jarrian Jones
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Eric Murray
injury_reports.summary: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Monday that Murray (elbow) will miss the remainder of the season, Demetrius Harvey of The Florida Times-Union reports.

injury_reports.name: Travon Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker (ribs) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Cam Little
injury_reports.summary: Little nailed all six extra-point attempts in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Ross Matiscik
injury_reports.summary: Matiscik (shoulder) does not have a game designation for Sunday's clash against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson

injury_reports.name: Khalil Herbert

injury_reports.name: James Pearce Jr.

injury_reports.name: Corey Bullock
injury_reports.summary: Bullock (quadriceps) exited Thursday's 27-19 loss to Green Bay and did not return, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Coker
injury_reports.summary: Coker secured two of five targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Trevor Etienne
injury_reports.summary: Etienne posted six carries for eight yards, reeled in both targets for 17 yards and compiled 69 kickoff-return yards during Sunday's 43-13 defeat to the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Mitchell Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans gathered in both targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 43-13 loss versus Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Chuba Hubbard
injury_reports.summary: Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown and brought in seven of eight targets for 38 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Damien Lewis
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tetairoa McMillan
injury_reports.summary: McMillan brought in six of 11 targets for 57 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: John Metchie III
injury_reports.summary: Metchie recorded three receptions for 14 yards on three targets in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: David Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore didn't receive any playing time on offense and logged two snaps on special teams in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Torricelli Simpkins III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brycen Tremayne
injury_reports.summary: Tremayne finished with an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Darren Waller
injury_reports.summary: Waller corralled one of two targets for 11 yards during last Thursday's 27-19 loss at Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Young
injury_reports.summary: Young has been playing through a left knee issue since initially suffering the injury in Week 3 against the Browns, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Bobby Brown III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Will Lee III
injury_reports.summary: Lee (hamstring) is day to day but should have a chance to "test" his injury this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Devin Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: Lloyd posted four tackles in Sunday's loss to the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Bobby Okereke
injury_reports.summary: Okereke tallied 10 tackles (seven solo) and a defensed pass in Sunday's loss to Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Jaelan Phillips
injury_reports.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Phillips (hamstring) is trending in the right direction and considered day-to-day heading into Sunday's game against the Broncos, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Fitzgerald
injury_reports.summary: Fitzgerald made both field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try in Thursday's 27-19 loss to Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Jonathon Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks (core) was seen working off to the side during the Panthers' unofficial practice Tuesday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Akayleb Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans (triceps) was placed on injured reserve by the Panthers on Thursday, Darin Gantt of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Legette
injury_reports.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Nate Adkins
injury_reports.summary: Adkins caught both of his targets for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 63 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: J.K. Dobbins
injury_reports.summary: Dobbins carried the ball seven times for 13 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Sam Ehlinger
injury_reports.summary: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will be the third emergency quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan Engram
injury_reports.summary: Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Mims (ankle) practiced fully Thursday,Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Bo Nix
injury_reports.summary: Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City. He added four rushing yards on three carries and threw a two-point conversion to Jaylen Waddle.

injury_reports.name: Cody Schrader
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos elevated Schrader from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Courtland Sutton
injury_reports.summary: Sutton (undisclosed) briefly left Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Waddle
injury_reports.summary: Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Kris Abrams-Draine
injury_reports.summary: Abrams-Draine (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest versus the Chiefs, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Zach Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Talanoa Hufanga
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brandon Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's contest against the Chiefs, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Taylor Rapp
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos signed Rapp off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Alex Singleton
injury_reports.summary: Singleton recorded 19 tackles (12 solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 30-16 win at Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Pat Surtain II
injury_reports.summary: Surtain (ankle) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Wil Lutz
injury_reports.summary: Lutz made both field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: RJ Harvey
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Barion Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown hauled in all three targets for 57 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: CJ Donaldson
injury_reports.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Audric Estime
injury_reports.summary: The Saints claimed Estime off waivers from the Browns on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Noah Fant
injury_reports.summary: Fant gathered in all two targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 16-10 defeat against Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Juwan Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught one of three targets for seven yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Alvin Kamara
injury_reports.summary: Kamara carried the ball six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Lance
injury_reports.summary: Lance reeled in all two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Kendre Miller
injury_reports.summary: Miller rushed eight times for six yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Chris Olave
injury_reports.summary: Olave caught six of 10 targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Cesar Ruiz
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tyler Shough
injury_reports.summary: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Devaughn Vele
injury_reports.summary: Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Carl Granderson
injury_reports.summary: Granderson totaled four tackles, including 1.5 sacks, in Sunday's Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Justin Reid
injury_reports.summary: Reid (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Jonas Sanker
injury_reports.summary: Sanker posted nine tackles (seven solo) in Sunday's Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Nathan Shepherd
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Pete Werner

injury_reports.name: Keenan Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught all seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Josh Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs caught four of five targets for 23 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: DJ Giddens
injury_reports.summary: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Gould
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Daniel Jones
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

injury_reports.name: Seth McGowan
injury_reports.summary: McGowan rushed five times for 29 yards and returned four kickoffs for 103 yards Sunday in a loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Drew Ogletree
injury_reports.summary: Ogletree (knee) is active Week 8 against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Richardson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Richardson entered the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday for an ineffective Daniel Jones with 11:45 remaining and completed both his pass attempts for eight yards while rushing twice for four yards.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor rushed eight times for 23 yards and brought in four of five targets for 24 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren secured four of 10 targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Adetomiwa Adebawore
injury_reports.summary: Adebawore agreed Tuesday with the Colts on a two-year, $35 million contract extension, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: CJ Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (ankle) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Boettcher
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Akeem Davis-Gaither
injury_reports.summary: Davis-Gaither recorded seven tackles (three solo) in Sunday's loss to Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Sauce Gardner
injury_reports.summary: Gardner (calf) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Haulcy
injury_reports.summary: Haulcy produced nine tackles (five solo) in a loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Justin Walley

injury_reports.name: Kevin Coleman Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Coleman caught all three of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Greg Dulcich
injury_reports.summary: Dulcich caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Ollie Gordon II
injury_reports.summary: Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

injury_reports.name: Will Kacmarek
injury_reports.summary: Kacmarek (hamstring) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's battle against the Patriots, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

injury_reports.name: Kadyn Proctor
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Malik Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England.

injury_reports.name: Jared Wayne
injury_reports.summary: Wayne (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game versus the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Malik Willis
injury_reports.summary: Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Wright
injury_reports.summary: Wright rushed two times for five yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: JuJu Brents
injury_reports.summary: Brents (neck/concussion) is active for Sunday's game against New England.

injury_reports.name: Jordyn Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks posted nine tackles (five solo) during the Dolphins' win Sunday over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Willie Gay Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Gay (illness) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Malik Herring
injury_reports.summary: Herring (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against New England.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Rodriguez
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez tallied four tackles (one solo) during Miami's win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Reese Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor (quadriceps) is active against the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Zane Gonzalez
injury_reports.summary: Gonzalez reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.

items.name: Kadyn Proctor
items.impact: Reported Questionable: OT starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Malik Herring
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at DE may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
injury_reports.summary: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 153 yards and a touchdown while bringing in two of four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jared Goff
injury_reports.summary: Goff completed 18 of 25 passes for 176 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added three carries for no gain in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sam LaPorta
injury_reports.summary: LaPorta caught three of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added two rushing yards on one attempt.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Saylors
injury_reports.summary: Saylors (neck) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

injury_reports.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
injury_reports.summary: St. Brown secured seven of eight targets for 46 yards and rushed once for 10 yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Isaac TeSlaa
injury_reports.summary: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sione Vaki
injury_reports.summary: Vaki rushed 11 times for 65 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added one catch for five yards on one target.

injury_reports.name: Jameson Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams brought in four of six targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brian Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Jack Campbell
injury_reports.summary: The Lions announced Monday that "preliminary indications are positive" for Campbell (neck), who continues to rest and recover at a Detroit-area hospital.

injury_reports.name: Roger McCreary
injury_reports.summary: McCreary (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Ennis Rakestraw Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rakestraw (ankle) does not have a game designation for Sunday's Week 8 tilt versus the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: D.J. Reed
injury_reports.summary: Reed (hip) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

injury_reports.name: DJ Wonnum
injury_reports.summary: Wonnum (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Rock Ya-Sin
injury_reports.summary: Ya-Sin (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Jake Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates made two of his three field-goal attempts and his sole PAT in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kerby Joseph
injury_reports.summary: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said Tuesday that Joseph (knee) will not play in Week 9 against the Dolphins, but is expected to see scout-team reps, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

injury_reports.name: Cade Mays
injury_reports.summary: Mays sustained a low-ankle sprain during Detroit's win over the Vikings on Sunday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Isiah Pacheco
injury_reports.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

injury_reports.name: Jimmy Rolder
injury_reports.summary: ir

injury_reports.name: John Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates (shoulder) is active for Sunday night's matchup with the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Treylon Burks
injury_reports.summary: Burks (foot) caught three of five targets for 81 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Jayden Daniels
injury_reports.summary: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Stefon Diggs
injury_reports.summary: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Austin Ekeler
injury_reports.summary: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Van Jefferson
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
injury_reports.summary: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback Sunday night against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Jaylin Lane
injury_reports.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Mariota
injury_reports.summary: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Chig Okonkwo
injury_reports.summary: Okonkwo tallied two catches (on four targets) for 32 yards during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Rachaad White
injury_reports.summary: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Antonio Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Javon Kinlaw
injury_reports.summary: Kinlaw (knee) was placed on injured reserve by the Commanders on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Charles Omenihu
injury_reports.summary: Omenihu (groin/ankle) is active for Sunday night's contest against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Daron Payne
injury_reports.summary: Payne (foot) was placed on injured reserve by the Commanders on Tuesday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Sonny Styles
injury_reports.summary: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

injury_reports.name: Drew Stevens
injury_reports.summary: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Terry McLaurin
injury_reports.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy McNichols
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders placed McNichols (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
injury_reports.summary: Newton (pectoral) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Laremy Tunsil
injury_reports.summary: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Tutu Atwell
injury_reports.summary: Atwell wasn't targeted in Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Dean Connors
injury_reports.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Connors sustained a broken hand in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers and will require surgery, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum rushed 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Konata Mumpfield
injury_reports.summary: Mumpfield caught one of two targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win at Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: Nacua secured 11 of 12 targets for 80 yards and a touchdown in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Whittington
injury_reports.summary: Whittington failed to reel in his lone target and logged one tackle on kick coverage during the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown and brought in his sole target for three yards in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl logged four tackles (two solo) during the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake finished Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders with seven tackles (four solo).

injury_reports.name: Nate Landman
injury_reports.summary: Landman (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chargers, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Trent McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie (back) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Chargers, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Grant Stuard
injury_reports.summary: Stuard is battling a hamstring injury, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (shoulder) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's contest against the Chargers, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Cardona
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brandon McManus
injury_reports.summary: McManus converted his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Davante Adams
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

injury_reports.name: Terrance Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Monday that it is "looking more likely than not" Ferguson (ankle) will practice this week, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: Coach Sean McVay indicated Monday that Garrett (knee) is on track to practice this week, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

"The whole time my mindset was, we have a little issue going on right now and I feel like I'm the type of player and the type of leader that can help us get out of it," Barkley sai

injury_reports.name: Brandon Aiyuk
injury_reports.summary: Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

injury_reports.name: Kaelon Black
injury_reports.summary: Black rushed 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of three targets for minus-4 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday. He also lost a fumble and returned one kickoff for 34 yards.

injury_reports.name: Brandin Cooks
injury_reports.summary: Cooks caught one of three targets for 13 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Cowing
injury_reports.summary: Cowing caught three of five passes for 38 yards, added a 10-yard carry and returned one kickoff for 28 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Mike Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordan James
injury_reports.summary: James logged a six-yard carry, turned his lone target into an 11-yard catch and registered 119 yards on four kickoff returns during the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Juszczyk
injury_reports.summary: Juszczyk caught all three of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Christian Kirk
injury_reports.summary: Kirk played 20 snaps on offense but didn't show up in the box score otherwise during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: George Kittle
injury_reports.summary: Kittle brought in eight of 10 targets for 88 yards and lost a fumble in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Christian McCaffrey
injury_reports.summary: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

injury_reports.name: Brock Purdy
injury_reports.summary: Purdy completed 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and added two carries for five yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Watkins
injury_reports.summary: Watkins brought in three of six targets for 56 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bosa
injury_reports.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Bosa (knee) "has a chance" to return to action Nov. 8 versus the Raiders following a Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Luke Gifford
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Dre Greenlaw
injury_reports.summary: Greenlaw posted 12 tackles (four solo) in Sunday's loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Marques Sigle
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Upton Stout
injury_reports.summary: Stout (shoulder) was only active as an emergency depth option during Sunday's loss to the Falcons, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reported Monday.

injury_reports.name: Garret Wallow
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Fred Warner
injury_reports.summary: Warner recorded 13 tackles (six solo) Sunday in a Week 7 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Eddy Pineiro
injury_reports.summary: Pineiro did not attempt a field goal while going 2-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Demarcus Robinson
injury_reports.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injury_reports.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
injury_reports.summary: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Bech
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders activated Bech (forearm) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Cousins completed 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets. He added five rushing attempts for three yards and a rushing touchdown.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Jeanty rushed twice for nine yards while catching three of four targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer caught five of six targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught all four targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Ian Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker did not catch his only target Sunday in the Raiders' 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington rushed 25 times for 83 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Maxx Crosby
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders have no plans on trading Crosby before the Nov. 10 deadline, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Darien Porter
injury_reports.summary: Porter (groin) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay converted his sole field-goal attempt and all five PATs in the Raiders' 38-33 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Johnson
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders placed Johnson (neck) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Carter Runyon
injury_reports.summary: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: AJ Barner
injury_reports.summary: Barner brought in two of five targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_reports.summary: Charbonnet (knee) rushed six times for 23 yards and brought in three of four targets for six yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Charles Cross
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Sam Darnold
injury_reports.summary: Darnold completed 17 of 34 passes for 188 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Montorie Foster Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Seahawks elevated Foster from their practice squad Monday ahead of the team's matchup versus the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: George Holani
injury_reports.summary: Holani carried once for nine yards and failed to haul in his lone target in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears. He also returned six kickoffs for 144 yards.

injury_reports.name: Tory Horton
injury_reports.summary: Horton recorded three receptions for 26 yards on six targets in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Velus Jones Jr.
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Cooper Kupp
injury_reports.summary: Kupp caught one of three targets for a seven-yard touchdown Monday in a loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Drew Lock
injury_reports.summary: Lock (coach's decision/elbow) is inactive for Monday's matchup with the Bears but serving as the team's emergency quarterback, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jadarian Price
injury_reports.summary: Price rushed 10 times for 29 yards and brought in two of four targets for eight yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Rashid Shaheed
injury_reports.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Tuesday that Shaheed (knee) has a chance to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
injury_reports.summary: Smith-Njigba brought in six of 11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Emanuel Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson played just seven snaps -- all on special teams -- in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Tyrice Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight (hip) doesn't have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Byron Murphy II
injury_reports.summary: Murphy (back) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Uchenna Nwosu
injury_reports.summary: Nwosu (ankle) is inactive for Monday's clash with the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Connor O'Toole
injury_reports.summary: O'Toole (hamstring) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Pili
injury_reports.summary: Pili (back) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chazz Surratt
injury_reports.summary: Surratt (calf) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Leonard Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams sustained a stinger during Monday's game against the Bears and is questionable to return.

injury_reports.name: Jason Myers
injury_reports.summary: Myers missed his lone field-goal attempt and made one of two PATs in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier is slated to work as Arizona's No. 1 running back for at least the next four weeks after Jeremiyah Love (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Beck will serve as the Cardinals' No. 2 quarterback behind starter Gardner Minshew in Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Brissett will be removed from the starting role and serve as the Cardinals' No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injury_reports.name: Simi Fehoko
injury_reports.summary: Fehoko is listed as a starting receiver on the Cardinals' unofficial depth chart heading into Sunday's game at Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jon Gaines II
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Knight is in the concussion protocol following Sunday's overtime win in Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride hauled in seven of eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory at Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Gardner Minshew II
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Wallace III
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals elevated Wallace to the active roster Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jayden Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson said after Sunday's 33-30 win at Dallas that he suffered two broken ribs during the contest, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Mack Wilson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Wilson (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: Wingard (knee) is active for Sunday's game versus the Cowboys, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland converted both of his field-goal attempts and three of four PATs in Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Brown
injury_reports.summary: When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday, "We'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

injury_reports.name: Ben Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: DeMario Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Hunter Henry
injury_reports.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back

injury_reports.name: Corey Kiner
injury_reports.summary: Kiner rushed four times for 13 yards in Thursday's Week 7 loss to Chicago. He also returned four kickoffs for 102 yards.

injury_reports.name: Lan Larison
injury_reports.summary: The Patriots signed Larison off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Drake Maye
injury_reports.summary: Maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins. He added five rushing yards and a TD on eight carries.

injury_reports.name: Behren Morton
injury_reports.summary: Morton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Patriots' emergency third quarterback against the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Eli Raridon
injury_reports.summary: Raridon had one reception for five yards on four targets in New England's 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson carried the ball 19 times for 82 yards and caught all three of his targets for eight yards in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught his lone target for a 43-yard touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Carlton Davis III
injury_reports.summary: Davis (neck) is active against the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Christian Elliss
injury_reports.summary: Elliss (chest) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Gabe Jacas
injury_reports.summary: Jacas (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Miami, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones registered nine tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, and returned one punt for 19 yards in Thursday's loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Andy Borregales
injury_reports.summary: Borregales made one of his two field goals and all three PATs in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Mack Hollins
injury_reports.summary: Hollins (calf), who is eligible to be activated from IR this week, per Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald, could return to practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Travis Glover
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Matthew Golden
injury_reports.summary: Golden brought in seven of 13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers are aware of the prior physical abuse allegations involving Jacobs that recently surfaced and "anticipate him being a member" of the team moving forward, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

injury_reports.name: Tucker Kraft
injury_reports.summary: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: MarShawn Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: Lloyd rushed three times for seven yards and brought in his only target for nine yards in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Love
injury_reports.summary: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Bo Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton caught one of his two targets for four yards and logged a 24-yard kickoff return in the Packers' 20-17 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sean Rhyan
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Christian Watson
injury_reports.summary: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Savion Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught three passes on as many targets for 47 yards and turned two carries into four yards during the Packers' 20-17 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Zaire Franklin
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Isaiah McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie logged 11 tackles (six solo), one fumble and one fumble recovery during the Packers' 20-17 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Xavier McKinney
injury_reports.summary: McKinney posted 10 tackles (four solo) during Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Keisean Nixon
injury_reports.summary: Nixon (shoulder) is active for Thursday's game against Carolina, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Benjamin St-Juste
injury_reports.summary: St-Juste (hamstring) was estimated as a full participant on Monday's practice report, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams finished Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Lions with nine tackles (five solo) and one pass defense.

injury_reports.name: Devonte Wyatt
injury_reports.summary: Wyatt (ankle) is active for Thursday's game against the Panthers, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey Smack
injury_reports.summary: Smack converted three of four extra-point tries and didn't attempt a field goal Thursday in a 27-19 win over Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Micah Parsons
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers' "intention" is for Parsons (knee) to resume practicing in Week 9, Weston Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports. "It's gonna be a process trying to get him back," LaFleur said. "We're hopeful he'll be able to get out there sometime this week."

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden secured seven of nine targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Stephen Carlson
injury_reports.summary: The Bears elevated Carlson from their practice squad Monday ahead of the team's matchup versus Seattle.

injury_reports.name: Roschon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson carried five times for 17 yards and added an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Case Keenum
injury_reports.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's matchup against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland secured seven of nine targets for 65 yards and lost a fumble in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in four of six targets for 87 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond finished Monday's 34-17 win against Seattle with two catches for 14 yards on three targets along with one rush for 39 yards.

injury_reports.name: Sam Roush
injury_reports.summary: Roush went without a target while playing 37 of the Bears' 70 snaps on offense in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Zavier Scott
injury_reports.summary: Chicago signed Scott from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams completed 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed twice for one yard in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Edwards
injury_reports.summary: Edwards (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Monday's tilt against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Gordon
injury_reports.summary: Gordon recorded five tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: D'Marco Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (ankle) is active for Monday night's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Grady Jarrett
injury_reports.summary: Jarrett (groin) is doubtful to return to Monday night's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Malik Muhammad II
injury_reports.summary: Muhammad (toe) is inactive for Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jack Sanborn
injury_reports.summary: Sanborn (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jeffery Simmons
injury_reports.summary: Simmons was traded to the Bears on Thursday, along with a 2028 fifth-round pick, in exchange for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028, as well as a 2027 fourth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Kentavius Street
injury_reports.summary: Street (knee) will not return to Monday night's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos made both field-goal tries and all four PATs in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Coby Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Coach Ben Johnson said Wednesday that Bryant (knee) will start running again in the "near future," Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at DT may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Graham Barton
injury_reports.summary: Barton (illness) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalon Daniels
injury_reports.summary: Daniels was back in his primary reserve role behind Baker Mayfield in Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Emeka Egbuka
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Kenny Gainwell
injury_reports.summary: Gainwell rushed 25 times for 140 yards in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Godwin failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Luke Goedeke
injury_reports.summary: Goedeke (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ted Hurst III
injury_reports.summary: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Bucky Irving
injury_reports.summary: Irving rushed 27 times for 170 yards and a touchdown in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tez Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson is in line to see additional snaps and targets in Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Falcons, as Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) remains sidelined for the contest per Scott Smith of the team's official site.

injury_reports.name: Baker Mayfield
injury_reports.summary: Mayfield failed to complete any of his three pass attempts in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also rushed four times for 14 yards.

injury_reports.name: Cade Otton
injury_reports.summary: Otton wasn't targeted in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Sean Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker didn't play any offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Yaya Diaby
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said that Diaby (knee) has been diagnosed with an MCL sprain and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Bears, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Zyon McCollum
injury_reports.summary: McCollum (illness) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

injury_reports.name: Tykee Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith posted seven tackles (one solo), an interception and a blocked extra-point attempt Sunday in a 43-13 Week 7 win against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Josiah Trotter
injury_reports.summary: Trotter (illness) was a full participant at the Buccaneers' practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Winfield (ribs) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chase McLaughlin
injury_reports.summary: McLaughlin made all three field-goal attempts and his only extra-point try in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Josh Hayes
injury_reports.summary: Hayes suffered a small setback in his recovery from a knee injury, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Rozeboom
injury_reports.summary: Rozeboom (finger) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: David Sills V
injury_reports.summary: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.
